title: Output channel integration and navigation
description:
Integrate HAR call recording with VS Code output channels:

**Requirements:**
- Create output channel per registered extension: 'harvisualizer-[unique-id]'
- Log each received call to appropriate output channel
- Double-click handler on output channel entries
- On double-click: open harvisualizer view with the JSONC file and select/expand the clicked call

**Technical Considerations:**
- Output channel line format (must be parseable for navigation)
- Link output channel lines to call IDs in JSONC file
- Command registration for opening from output channel
- URI/position tracking for call selection

title: Extension API for recording HAR calls
description:
Create public API for other VS Code extensions to send HAR calls to harvisualizer:

**API Requirements:**
- Registration endpoint: extensions provide unique ID
- Send call endpoint: accept HAR-formatted call data
- Proper TypeScript API surface for extension authors

**Registration Flow:**
- Extension calls registration with unique ID
- Create output channel named 'harvisualizer-[unique-id]'
- Create JSONC file in workspace storage for this extension
- Return registration handle/token

**Technical Considerations:**
- VS Code extension API exports
- Type definitions for external consumers
- Validation of incoming data
- Handle multiple registered extensions simultaneously

title: JSONL file format support
description:
Add support for parsing and streaming JSONL (JSON Lines) files:

**File Format:**
- Each line is a separate JSON document
- Each line has the shape of a HAR file structure
- Each line can contain any number of records

**Requirements:**
- Line-by-line streaming parser
- Incremental parsing (don't load entire file into memory)
- Integration with existing streaming visualization
- Handle malformed lines gracefully (skip or report errors)

**Technical Considerations:**
- readline-based or buffered line reading
- JSON parsing per line
- Extract records from HAR-shaped structure on each line
- Error handling for invalid JSON or unexpected structure

title: Recording file cleanup and retention management
description:
Manage lifecycle of recorded HAR call files:

**Requirements:**
- Command to view/manage old recording files
- Configurable retention period (default: 7 days)
- Automatic deletion of files older than retention period
- User confirmation before deletion
- Settings for retention configuration

**Features:**
- List all recording files with age and size
- Manual delete option
- Bulk delete expired files
- Configuration: harvisualizer.recordingRetentionDays (default: 7)

**Technical Considerations:**
- File metadata (creation time)
- Background cleanup task (on activation?)
- Settings integration
- QuickPick UI for file selection

title: JSONC file persistence for recorded calls
description:
Persist recorded HAR calls to JSONC files in workspace storage:

**Requirements:**
- Create JSONC file per registered extension in workspace storage
- Append each received call to the appropriate JSONC file
- File format: array of HAR calls with metadata (timestamp, call ID, etc.)
- Ensure file integrity (atomic writes, error handling)

**Technical Considerations:**
- Workspace storage location (globalStorageUri or workspaceStorage)
- JSONC format (allows comments, useful for debugging)
- Incremental file updates (append without full rewrite)
- File locking/concurrency if needed
- Call ID generation for cross-referencing with output channel

title: Dynamic loading for streaming visualization
description:
Implement dynamic loading to optimize memory usage during streaming:

**Requirements:**
- Only send records that will be visualized to the view
- View can request more records from the provider (forward loading)
- View can re-request older records (backward loading/history)
- Streaming service tracks source file position for rollback capability
- Configurable in-memory record limit (default: 1000 entries)

**Technical Considerations:**
- File position tracking for seeking backwards
- Circular buffer or similar structure for memory-bounded storage
- Pagination/windowing API between view and streaming service
- Cache eviction strategy when limit exceeded

title: Live view updates for active recordings
description:
Automatically update harvisualizer view when new calls arrive:

**Requirements:**
- Detect if harvisualizer view is currently showing a recording file
- When new call is written to that file, update the view in real-time
- No full reload - incrementally add new entries
- Maintain scroll position and selection state

**Technical Considerations:**
- File watcher or direct notification from API
- Incremental UI updates (don't re-render everything)
- Handle edge cases: rapid updates, large batches
- WebView message protocol for updates
